meta.name: Cloud Whale
meta.description: Fire it like a shell, then press FIRE again while it flies: a huge whale made of storm cloud pops out of the shell right there, hangs for a heartbeat and then free-falls, slamming nose first into whatever is below. A big crater, a shockwave that throws tanks, and the whale bursts into a flood of water that fills the crater and puts out any fire. Never pressed? The whale drops onto the spot where the shell lands.
